title: Mixed Event — Connected Through SEKAI's Cherry Blossoms — Episode3 A Show with Cherry Blossoms?!

meta.Episode: Episode3 — A Show with Cherry Blossoms?!
meta.Event Outline: In the Empty SEKAI, Miku's words inspire a discussion among Kanade and the others about having a cherry blossom viewing party. Meanwhile, everyone in the other SEKAI is also planning ways to make the most of the season...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: S-So bright...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Is this a field...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(...?
Wait, there's something in the air...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Cherry blossom petals...?
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ready, you guys?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes!
Everyone's all here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Great! Then, let's start our brainstorming session for our next show!

rows.Speaker: Luka & MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
This is going to be so fun with all of us here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I agree.
Why don't we get right down to our ideas? Any thoughts regarding our next show?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Well, I think it should be a really fun and exciting show!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Fun and exciting...?
Yeah, it'd be nice to put on a show that made the fans and us all feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: At the same time, we should probably choose a theme of some sort. That'll probably help us make this show as fun as it can be.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. Choosing a theme should also allow us to work out the finer details, all of which will be important in terms of putting on a good show.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Speaking of which, aren't Minori and the girls always saying that it's important to pick a theme when coming up with stream ideas?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, let's start by picking a theme...! Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Just in the nick of time♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, everyone's on stage today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're right!
Their aura's so bright when they're all together...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, girls!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why don't you join us on stage?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, thanks.
What were you discussing just now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We were just talking about what kind of theme we should pick for our next show!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Should we go? Are we interrupting...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, not at all!
We'd love to hear your opinions as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that'd be nice.
What do you say? Do you have some time to stick around...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We'd love to help!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Minori!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, I know this is a bit sudden, but got any good ideas?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... A theme that can help make a show fun and exciting...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
You can look at this a lot of different ways...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, how about something that feels seasonal...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's spring now...
So how about a “Spring Show”...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
A spring show?
That sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, spring...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's a season that's all about sprouting and growth, so we could do a show that lets everyone see “a new side of us”.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Look at you, Len.
You wrapped everything up with a nice bow♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you all so much!
I think we have our theme now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We're always glad to be of service.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, we'll be doing a spring show where we'll be showing everyone “a new side of us”!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I can't wait to see it...!
I bet it's gonna be a really exciting show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you, Minori.
We'll be doing everything we can to make sure everyone enjoys it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, why don't we start hammering out some of the details? What would you all like to do during our spring show?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
What if we had cherry blossom petals rain down everywhere?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Petals?
Yes, that'd be wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I know, right?
Minori told me about this time she sang under some cherry blossom trees, so I wanna try doing it too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You did, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh... You mean that time?
She's talking about when I sang under these cherry blossom trees with a couple of friends from school.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It was a lot of fun, and those trees were so pretty!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I had no idea.
Cherry blossoms are perfect for the stage and make it just that much more fun to sing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, I like that idea too.
Cherry blossoms falling from the sky would make everything feel so romantic...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'd love to see that too!
It'll be an amazing spectacle!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks!
But... I kinda want an actual tree there during the show and not just petals...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A cherry blossom tree?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Wouldn't it be even more romantic if we had an actual tree on stage?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're talking about a real tree...?
That means we'd have to carry one over somehow, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! My guess is that there are so many stages around here that there's bound to be one with a cherry blossom tree!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see your point, but I have a feeling we would've found it by now if it's really out there...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It's a great idea, Rin, but I'm not sure if we can really put it into practice.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, let's go look for it...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If we don't find one, we can just go with flower petals alone. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, we'll help too!
Let's go find that tree!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Awesome!
Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No...
Not a single one...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All these stages but no trees.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: To be fair, it's not exactly common for idols to have a tree standing in the middle of their stage during shows.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As unfortunate as it is, we may have to give up on this idea.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you like to do a show our way in addition to your other show...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There might not be any cherry blossom trees here, but I thought that it'd be nice to do an after-show over there while having a little picnic.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we'll need to be discrete so that no one sees what we're doing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, really...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's an incredible idea.
It'd be great to give that a try.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! I'll throw some food together for us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'll help.
Hehe. I'm sure it'll be a lovely picnic.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay...!
Thanks a bunch...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Good for you, Rin♪
Alright, why don't we start preparing for it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, let's!
Stay tuned, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What if we had some cherry blossoms appear on the rear display?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We could even use pink lights to make everything feel more spring-like.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Everyone's being so nice about this.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (For their sake, I have to make sure this show goes well!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I still think it'd be better to have an actual cherry blossom tree on stage...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh...?
There's something sparkly backstage...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What could it be? Did a light fall down or something?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It's round and shiny...
Oh, is it one of the new lights that KAITO was talking about?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It looks hot. Maybe I can prod it with... Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It's a fragment of a feeling!
Eep!
